name: tty-abort-no-orphan
description: Escaping a tool approval aborts the turn before the model said anything, and that turn leaves no trace in history: the next turn is sent only its own message instead of following an orphaned request the model never answered

steps.name: submit - the model calls create and waits for approval
screenContains: Enter to confirm · Esc to deny

steps.name: deny with Esc - the turn unwinds having produced nothing
second turn is answered, which it only can be if history is still empty
submit - the fixture's messageCount: 1 matcher is the history assertion
